title: Deicing chemicals.
officialText:
For concrete exposed to freezing and thawing in the presence of moisture and deicing chemicals,
the maximum weight of fly ash, other pozzolans, silica fume or slag that is included in the concrete shall not exceed the
percentages of the total weight of cementitious materials permitted by Table 1904.4.2.
